title: Kenyan Sweet Potato Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from East Africa, made with roasted sweet potatoes and spices.

ingredients.name: Kenyan sweet potatoes
ingredients.notes: Choose sweet potatoes with a rich, orange color

ingredients.name: Jazzy carrots
ingredients.notes: Add a pop of color with a jazzy carrot

ingredients.name: Golden olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality golden olive oil for a rich flavor

ingredients.name: Tagine spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of warming spices, typically including cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chop the onion finely for even cooking

instructions: Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with 1 tablespoon of golden olive oil, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the sweet potatoes are roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of golden olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the tagine spices and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the roasted sweet potatoes, carrots, and enough water to cover the ingredients. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or parsley if desired.
